pose.note: The pointer command aims from the garden entry checkpoint toward the west-wall painting and lowers the default camera pitch toward its 0.14 radian limit. The raster records the resulting settled view; it does not record the final numeric camera pose.

limits: The direct canvas hit did not complete in this real-raster capture. The input E2E separately passed mouse and touch at yaw pi/2 and (250, 115); that verified target belongs to the E2E pose, not this final framing raster.
The inspector's emitted phone and tablet styles are covered separately by built-ui.json and built-*-artwork.png, whose helper deliberately suppresses scene draw calls.
The frame contact guarantee is derived from measured GLB geometry and its focused content regression; this raster is supporting visual evidence.
